2) 15m — Clarion architecture & data flow questions (security/compliance brief)

4) 20m — perf expectations, batching/caching tradeoffs, quantization impacts
5) 10m — next steps, mutual action items (procurement, trial access, doc handoffs)

- Please share the attendee list and any compliance contacts (security lead) who should join.
- If you have a short list of peak request shapes or token distribution, send that as a CSV so we can bring profiling suggestions.

I'll send a calendar invite once Ben confirms the roster. Attaching the discovery notes you provided and our short preflight checklist for the session.
